description: Migration creates contact_locations (tenant, contact_name_id, location_id, is_primary, created_at, created_by) with PK (tenant, contact_name_id, location_id), composite FK to contacts ON DELETE CASCADE, composite FK to client_locations ON DELETE RESTRICT, partial unique (tenant, contact_name_id) WHERE is_primary, index (tenant, location_id)
Migration distributes contact_locations by tenant co-located with contacts on Citus and skips FKs only where distribution is incompatible, mirroring 20260518120000_add_location_id_to_assets.cjs
Migration adds contacts.work_arrangement text null with CHECK IN ('on_site','hybrid','remote')
contact_locations registered in packages/db tenantTableManifest (ordered deletion) and in ee/temporal-workflows tenant-deletion order before contacts and client_locations; golden test updated
packages/types: IContactLocation interface; IContact gains work_arrangement and locations[]; ContactWorkArrangement union type
packages/clients/src/models/contactLocation.ts replaceContactLocations(trx, tenant, contactId, links) replaces the set in one transaction with tenant-scoped queries
replaceContactLocations rejects a location that does not exist or belongs to another client with ContactLocationClientMismatch, and rejects more than one is_primary
replaceContactLocations marks a single link primary when none is flagged
addContact accepts work_arrangement and locations[] and writes links in the same transaction as the contact
updateContact accepts work_arrangement and locations[]; omitted locations leaves links unchanged, empty array removes all
updateContact with a new client_id deletes all contact_locations rows for the contact in the same transaction and returns removedLocationCount
getContactLocationCount(contactId) server action for the client-change confirmation

packages/clients/src/lib/contactLocations.ts attachContactLocations(db, tenant, rows, idOf) does one batched read and attaches locations[] (with address fields, is_primary, is_active) and primaryLocation to each row
getContactByContactNameId, getContactsByClient, getAllContacts and the contact bento loader return work_arrangement, locations[] and primaryLocation via attachContactLocations
shared/models/contactLocation.ts resolveContactLocationId(trx, tenant, contactId): remote → null; primary link; else only link; else client default active location; else null
clientLocation.deleteLocation counts contact_locations and adds 'N contact(s)' to the dependency error; deactivation keeps links

Client merge: contacts and client_locations re-parent wholesale via CLIENT_OWNED_MOVE_TABLES so contact_locations rows need no change; the engine asserts link count before equals after and that every link's contact and location share a client after the merge

ContactLocationsEditor component (id contact-locations-editor): work-arrangement select, multi-select of the client's active locations (linked inactive ones listed and marked), primary radio; disabled with hint until a client is chosen
Contact edit form and bento edit drawer use ContactLocationsEditor; changing the client clears the selection and, when the contact has links, shows a confirmation naming the removal count before save
QuickAddContact includes ContactLocationsEditor collapsed under Locations, enabled once a client is chosen

Contact bento Locations tile (id contact-bento-locations): work-arrangement badge, one row per location with name, address line, Primary and Inactive markers; empty state with Add action; 'Remote' when remote with no links
Contacts.tsx and ClientContactsList.tsx add a sortable Location column: primary name, '+N' for extra links, 'Remote' when remote and unlinked
Client contacts tab Location filter with the client's locations plus Remote and No location options
ClientLocations cards show a contact count chip (id client-location-contact-count-<id>) expanding to contact names linking to each contact; count loaded in one batched action per client
ClientLocations delete surfaces the contact dependency error text unchanged (no silent failure, no cascade)
ContactPicker row type gains primaryLocation and work_arrangement; option rows and the selected row render the location name as secondary text after EntityTagBadges
Every action feeding ContactPicker (getContactsByClient, getAllContacts, picker search) attaches primaryLocation in the same batched pass as displayTags
Ticket contact tile (TicketBentoLayout, TicketProperties) shows the requester's primary location under the tag chips

TicketModel.createTicket resolves location_id via resolveContactLocationId when location_id is undefined and contact_name_id is set; null is kept as explicit none; same-client check runs on the resolved value
getContactEffectiveLocation(contactId) server action returning the resolved location and the contact's links for the ticket forms

QuickAddTicket tracks locationSource (user | contact | none); contact select fills an empty or contact-filled location with the resolved one and never replaces a user-chosen one; clearing the contact clears a contact-filled location
QuickAddTicket location select groups 'Contact's locations' (primary first, marked) before 'Other locations'; submits null for explicit None and omits the field when untouched
TicketDetails.handleContactChange sets the resolved location when the ticket has none and records a contact-derived location change in ticket history
Ticket contact tile shows a one-click 'Use contact's location' hint when the ticket location is not among the contact's locations; existing locations are never overwritten without the click
Inbound email passes location precedence: contact explicit location (primary or only link; remote skips) → inbound defaults location when clients match → undefined
Portal createClientTicket passes location_id undefined so the model fills it from the portal user's contact
RecurringClientOverridesDialog pre-fills the location from the chosen contact when empty; generation leaves an unset override to the model rule
Ticket query schema adds location_id uuid column attribute (equals, in, not_in, is_empty, is_not_empty) and contact.locations set attribute over contact_locations (in, not_in, is_empty, is_not_empty)
Conformance rows for location_id and contact.locations added to packages/predicates/spec/conformance.json and SEMANTICS.md; evaluator, SQL compiler and JSONata backends pass

WhereTagFilterDescriptor generalised to WhereFilterDescriptor with an options source ({tags} | {locations: 'ticket' | 'contact'}); toolbar control, active chips and clear derive from the table; two new rows Location and Requester location
Location filter options: the filtered client's locations, or all tenant locations grouped by client when no client filter is set
ticketPredicateFields exposes both location paths for checklist predicates with a location control
Ticket list definition gets a Location column (off by default, available in the column picker) when none exists
REST v1 contactResponseSchema gains work_arrangement and locations[] with address fields; ContactService.getById/list attach them
REST v1 createContactSchema and updateContactSchema accept work_arrangement and locations[{location_id, is_primary?}]; cross-client location returns 400 with code contact_location_client_mismatch
GET /api/v1/contacts and /api/v1/clients/{id}/contacts accept location_id and work_arrangement filters
GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/locations rows include contact_count

Route docs in server/src/lib/api/openapi/routes/clientsContacts.ts describe locations, work_arrangement, the location_id and work_arrangement filters and contact_count on every contact and location operation; npm run generate:artifacts regenerates the OpenAPI spec and the MCP registry; spec synced to the developer portal
CSV export and template add work_arrangement, locations ('A; B') and primary_location columns
CSV import maps the three columns; MappableField union extended; a location name not found under the contact's client fails that row with a message naming it
Client portal ClientUserDetails shows a read-only Locations line (names, primary marked, remote badge); account action joins the links
Portal contact write paths reject locations and work_arrangement
ee/mobile api/contacts.ts: ContactDetail and ContactListItem gain work_arrangement and locations[]; ContactWriteInput gains both
ContactDetailScreen Locations section: rows with name, Primary marker, address; press opens buildMapsUrl(mapsQueryFromLines(address)) falling back to the location name; Remote badge beside the name

ContactFormModal work-arrangement select and location multi-select with primary toggle loaded from /api/v1/clients/{id}/locations, enabled once a client is set; contactForm validation enforces at most one primary
ContactsListScreen rows and ticket-detail ContactPickerModal show the primary location name as a secondary line
All new MSP, portal and mobile strings use t() with keys added to every shipped locale; glossary gates pass
Merge preview (clientMergePlan.ts) and merge report include the number of contact location links moving to the target
GET /api/v1/contacts/export and GET /api/v1/contacts/search rows carry work_arrangement, locations[] and primary location like the list response

Contact search indexer loads links per batch like phone numbers; primary location name joins the subtitle after the client name, all linked location names and cities join the body, remote adds 'Remote' to the body
Saving contact links reindexes the contact; renaming or deactivating a location reindexes every linked contact

MCP registry entries for contact and location operations mention the new parameters in their summaries so search_api_registry ranks them for location queries; call_api_endpoint passes location_id and work_arrangement filters through

Merge preview contacts carry locations[] (id, name, isPrimary) and workArrangement; preview carries locationsAfterMerge (source locations flagged fromSource plus target locations) and suggestedTargetLocationId per link when a target location name matches case- and whitespace-insensitively

MergeClientsDialog Contacts step adds a Locations column (id merge-contact-locations-<contactId>): multi-select of locationsAfterMerge with primary marker, pre-filled from current links, source locations labelled 'moving from <source>', Remote badge for remote contacts
Contacts step shows a 'Target also has <name>' hint with a one-click Use it that re-points that link to the target location; nothing is re-pointed without the click
Merge input contactLocationAssignments; engine applies replaceContactLocations per listed contact after the client-owned tables move; unlisted contacts keep their links

Engine and dry run reject a chosen location that is neither a moved source location nor a target location with a clear error; report counts contact location links and re-pointed links; confirm step shows both
